entries.subject: sign-in
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/02-after-signin.png (login form 01, authorized home 03; harness signIn=authorized in 21-live-harness-core-workflow.json)

entries.subject: tenant-switch
entries.reason: app-side switch to the second space fails on HEAD against the real deployment: runtime switchTenant sends POST /api/v1/auth/switch-tenant without an Authorization header -> 401 -> runtime falls to the upgrade-required surface (04b-upgrade-required-after-switch.png actually captures this; the file named 04-tenant-switched.png is the SAME upgrade-required screen, mislabeled by the prior agent — server-side switch-tenant with the header works via curl, so the defect is client-side); re-adjudication downgrades flow 2 from done to blocked

entries.subject: task
entries.reason: submission Start is structurally broken against a real HEAD backend: mobile createSession (packages/api-client/src/mobile/task-office.ts:124-126) omits engine_type, sessions default to engine 'builtin', and workbench admission rejects platform-driver runs on non-trpc sessions with 409 'agent runtime conflict' (06-flow3-submit-rejected-conflict.png, 22-backend-log-start-conflicts.txt); with an API-created trpc session the dispatch is accepted (202 queued) but no executor exists on this single-process stack — agent_runs stays queued forever, SSE detail opens with 0 events (07/08/09 pngs); read surfaces (agents/tasks/detail/inbox) all work

entries.subject: background-recovery
entries.reason: partial: >=35s background (Settings foreground, 10-flow4-backgrounded.png) -> resume restores the same detail state, zero duplicate Start dispatches (0 new POST in backend log), process PID unchanged — 11-flow4-after-foreground.png; the stream-resume leg is unverifiable because runs never execute on this stack (executor gap, see task entry), so the flow as specified cannot be fully claimed

entries.subject: offline-draft
entries.reason: the simulator has no airplane-mode toggle (simctl exposes no per-device network switch; host-level pf/networksetup changes are out of scope per plan); the in-package draft path is additionally broken: Keep draft -> kill -> relaunch LOSES the draft (12/13/14 pngs) and the task detail shows the local-save-failed label — the scoped-vault persistence fails in this Release build; the offline-vault live harness aborts at its online-admission precondition (same engine_type defect as task)

entries.subject: notification
entries.reason: no APNs credentials (unchanged); additionally the backend mobile-notification sweep loop errors every 2s with SQLSTATE 42703 'column d.app_id does not exist' (23-backend-notification-sweep-defect.txt) and no run ever emits events to trigger a notification; the local Inbox surface itself renders against the real deployment (15-flow6-inbox.png)

entries.subject: download-share
entries.reason: share sheet needs a task material; runs never execute on this stack so no material exists (16-flow7-materials-empty.png is the honest empty surface); true external share-sheet acceptance remains real-device per spec

entries.subject: voice-permission
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/17-flow8-mic-denied.png (simctl privacy revoke microphone -> Dictate -> actionable denied copy '麦克风权限被拒绝；可直接输入文字…' + Retry button, process alive)

entries.subject: secure-storage
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/21-live-harness-core-workflow.json (coldBootRestore=authorized-restored on the real deployment; in-app: authorized session survived multiple terminate/relaunch cycles, e.g. 04-tenant-switched-cold-restart.png) — scope: Keychain credential persistence; the scoped-vault (draft/task projection) save path FAILS in this build, see offline-draft

entries.subject: weak-network
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/20-weak-network-live-output.json — scope: first Start dispatch dropped after 2s, intent durably recorded BEFORE dispatch, reconcile keeps the SAME requestId with zero duplicate dispatches (weakNetwork=pending-retained on the live deployment); the reconciled-same-run convergence leg is blocked by the engine_type Start defect, not by the weak-network machinery

entries.subject: permission-denied
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/17-flow8-mic-denied.png (denied microphone: actionable copy, text input remains usable, no crash)

entries.subject: cold-start

entries.subject: revocation
entries.evidence: ios-evidence/t39/2026-10-02/19b-flow9-cold-start-login-settled.png (signOut -> terminate -> cold start stays on the Sign-in screen, no session revival; 18/19 pngs; harness revocation=revoked live in 21) — this closes the signOut-revocation scope gap left open by the 2026-09-26 round
